page.overview:
Who is Chelsea Joli?

Chelsea Joli is a Lahmian Sister posed as a servant to infiltrate the household of the Thurzo family. The eagle-eyed lady of the house, Erzebet Thurzo, spotted her new servant behaving strangely and discovered her true nature. Believing a Vampire's blood will keep her young and beautiful, Erzebet has had Chelsea locked up in the tower and hemmed in by holy symbols, periodically draining her blood to bathe in. Word of this has reached the Sisterhood, and Erzebet will swiftly be punished.

Chelsea's capture and drainage of her blood by Erzebet Thurzo is a reference to the tales that [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elizabeth_Báthory Erzsébet Báthory], a Hungarian noble woman and serial killer, bathed in virgin blood to remain youthful. Erzsébet's tale would latter be assotiated with the vampire mythos.
